scope: Development-session HTML5 target: launch, declared capability gaps, browser-measured telemetry, and one fingerprint-acknowledged hot reload. Event and page evidence only; no visual claim.

unavailable.name: frameDtMs
unavailable.reason: No application lifecycle is attached, so the engine never calls the browser host update. A component-only bundle measures no frame delta here; Defold's own frame timing is inside the Wasm engine.

unavailable.name: hermesHeapBytes
unavailable.reason: The browser runtime embeds no Hermes. performance.memory measures the page JavaScript heap and is reported as jsHeapBytes instead.

unavailable.name: hermesHeapPeakBytes
unavailable.reason: The browser runtime embeds no Hermes.

unavailable.name: luaHandles
unavailable.reason: The Lua value registry lives inside the Wasm engine and exports no counter to the browser host.

unavailable.name: arenaHighWaterBytes
unavailable.reason: The generated browser value bridge resets its per-call arena state and records no high-water mark; adding one is a generator change.

capabilityGaps.name: hermes-heap
capabilityGaps.reason: The browser runtime embeds no Hermes. performance.memory reports the page's JavaScript heap and is shown under its own name.

capabilityGaps.name: lua-handles
capabilityGaps.reason: The Lua value registry lives inside the Wasm engine and exports no counter to the browser host.

capabilityGaps.name: arena-high-water
capabilityGaps.reason: The generated browser value bridge resets per-call arena state and records no high-water mark; adding one is a generator change.

capabilityGaps.name: typed-native-transport
capabilityGaps.reason: typed-native is a transport of the Hermes runtime; the browser projection lowers every route to direct-memory instead.

capabilityGaps.name: engine-service-reload
capabilityGaps.reason: An HTML5 page exposes no Defold engine service, so a bundle is pushed into the page over CDP rather than posted as a resource reload.

capabilityGaps.name: wasm-rebuild-in-session
capabilityGaps.reason: A wasm-web engine is produced by Bob and Extender, not by this session. A TypeScript edit does not change the engine, so the session reloads the bundle inside the running page; changing the extension or game.project needs a new wasm-web bundle.

capabilityGaps.name: visual-verification
capabilityGaps.reason: Nothing here inspects the canvas. The observable surface is the console transcript, page errors, and what the page reports when asked.
